symptom: In the MCP editor an empty variable row counted as a connection change, hiding the tools and offering Save & connect; each failed save re-ran the connection check; and repeated outcomes stacked one toast per attempt.
rule: Compare drafts without the rows a save drops, keep a settled check of the same probe key across save and sign-in pauses, and give each editor one toast id. Advance a paused clock past the check debounce and count probes and live toasts (principles 3 and 14).
